skills.name: api_anything_search
skills.description: Search local specs and shared catalog for existing website API operations (e.g., 'youtube', 'flight prices', 'github').

query.description: Domain, site name, or search terms (e.g. 'youtube', 'hacker news')

skills.name: api_anything_list_operations
skills.description: Inspect operations, input parameter schemas, and notes for an available site.

skills.name: api_anything_call
skills.description: Execute a learned web API operation directly using high-speed raw HTTP (Tier 1).

args.description: Key-value arguments matching the operation schema

skills.name: api_anything_propose
skills.description: Scout an unmapped website or problem statement and synthesize an API Blueprint (trigger URL, 3 test arg sets, fields, auth strategy) with Gemini 2.5 Flash for human review.

problem.description: Description of the data or website to turn into an API (e.g. 'Track YouTube daily watch history')

skills.name: api_anything_learn
skills.description: Execute Chromium browser network capture, parameter slot learning, and NVIDIA NIM schema integrity validation for an approved blueprint.

blueprint.description: Approved API blueprint object containing site, op, trigger, args, args2, args3, fields, and authStrategy
